login.title: Log in / Sign up
login.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a login code. No password needed. Your account is created automatically the first time.
login.sent: We sent a login code to {email}. Check your inbox (valid for {minutes} minutes).
login.devCode: Dev mode (no email service configured): the login code is {code}

login.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address
login.wrongCode: Wrong code. {remaining, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left
login.codeExpired: This code no longer works (expired, already used, or too many wrong tries). Please request a new one
login.cooldown: A code was just sent. Please wait {seconds} seconds and try again
login.emailHourlyLimit: Too many codes sent to this email this hour. Please try again in an hour
login.ipHourlyLimit: Too many requests from this network this hour. Please try again in an hour
login.signupsFull: Sign-ups are full for today. Please come back tomorrow

review.forbidden: Your account doesn't have permission to review
review.commentTooLong: Overall comments can be at most {max} characters
review.noteTooLong: Each comment can be at most {max} characters
review.unknownAiNote: One of the AI comments couldn't be found. Please reload the page and try again
review.editedAiNoteEmpty: An edited AI comment can't be empty. Delete it instead
review.badPayload: Your review couldn't be sent. Please reload the page and try again

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.denied: Your account doesn't have permission for that page.

teacherDashboard.intro: Sets reviewed by another teacher disappear from your list automatically, so nothing gets reviewed twice.
teacherDashboard.empty: Nothing to review right now. Thank you!

aiVerdict.needs_human: AI has concerns, needs a teacher

accessHint.members: Listed: logged-in students and teachers can take it
accessHint.public: Public: anyone can try it, even without logging in (usually just one set)

statusTag.FULL_PASS: All passed: AI and teacher both approved
statusTag.AI_WARN: AI has concerns, please take a closer look
statusTag.TP: Approved by a teacher (can be taken)
statusTag.TR: Rejected by a teacher (can't be taken)
statusTag.WAIT: Waiting: no teacher has reviewed it yet (can't be taken)

trap.spelling: Spelling (letters read out one by one)
trap.paraphrase: Paraphrase (recording and question use different words)

answerPolicy.number_word: Digits or number words both accepted

review.wrongValue: (wrong answer heard first in the recording: {value})
review.wholeSetHint: Comments that aren't about one question, e.g. the story doesn't add up, or the whole recording is too fast.
review.playFrom: Listen from where the answer to question {n} is said
review.answerDetails: Answer details and where it's said
review.deleteReasonPlaceholder: Why doesn't this need fixing? (optional, the AI will see it)
review.transcriptHint: Click a time to jump there. The line being played is highlighted.
review.noTranscript: This set was packed before transcripts were included, so the ▶ buttons and the transcript aren't available.
review.unsavedComment: You have a comment you haven't saved. Press OK (or Cancel) on it first.
